question: What is the meaning of instructions for optimal use in relation to life cycle information?
description:
Instructions for optimal use in relation to life cycle information provide guidance on how to utilize a product or component in the most sustainable and efficient manner throughout its life cycle. This includes recommendations for maintenance, repair, recycling, or disposal to minimize environmental impact and maximize resource recovery. <|ENDINPUT>

reformulation of the top 3 goals revealed by this study (see Section 3.8).
